On Monday, October 26, 2015 at 2:48:14 PM UTC-4, Bob Carpenter wrote:
In case anyone's interested the paper finally came out:

http://www.jstatsoft.org/article/view/v067i01

In case anyone doesn't know whether they are interested, rstanarm uses the lme4 functions described in its section 2 to ensure that we use the same likelihood, term ordering, etc. So, suggestions about how to enhance stan_glmer() need to stay consistent with that.

Ben
